answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a farm in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The walnut cap is policed at intake and summit makes public the per-origin counts. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a harbor tag. That is 17 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
